Commander of the Order of Jack; Knight of the Regal Lion — The Order of Jack (founder and commander) / the Regal Lion (knight, formerly second-in-command) / the Iron Legion (by the Regal Lion's subordination, not by oath)

Status: Active — minor landed knight-commander at Vellanet Rise; Regal Lion second-in-command on detached service; unaware his brother Archie is missing

Jack Melvus Miser is the eldest of the five Miser children and the reason the rest of them eat well. A paladin of the Oath of Glory who joined the Regal Lion at fifteen, he ground his way up from squire to the order's second-in-command on bandit cordons, unpriceable monster contracts, and one daylight kill on a rampaging Fire Elemental Myrmidon in front of a whole market town. He now holds Vellanet Rise — a minor Midlands-periphery grant of a fortified manor, three villages, a mill and a quarry — and leads his own body of arms, the Order of Jack, whose famous 20,000 is a muster roll rather than an army. Locally he is a hero; a hundred miles away he is nobody. He lifted his mother Wanda and his siblings out of poverty exactly as he said he would at fifteen, and has not yet been told that the brother missing from the family portrait is wanted across three planes.

Status: Active — extracted from Mount Ebott, rewarded with monitored outside communication, then summoned to Gamma High Command after the final logger cutoff

The Gamma Agent is a lone legionary sent on a mission that history says is impossible. Belonging to the Gamma Expeditionary Force—a division that was supposedly wiped out 87 years ago—the agent arrived at Mount Ebott with a protocol book in one hand and a dispatch from a dead commissar in the other. Rigidly adhering to 'PROTOCOLS OF THE IRON LEGION VOLUME 1,' the agent navigated the descent into Snowdin through a mixture of luck, clumsiness, and by dragging Dracule Mihawk along for the ride. The agent is currently operating a 'star bit' powered survey machine to assess the structural integrity of the mountain.

From Leashed Agent to Indentured Archivist — Formerly Iron Legion (coerced), currently Shadow Estate Archives (indentured)

Status: Active — real injured Toadburt confirmed alive at the Shadow Estate portal circle with Tanukiburt and Mystic Morel

Toadburt's story is a masterclass in trading one cage for another. The Iron Legion strapped an entropy ring on him and sent him into the Feywild as a coerced operative. Now the ring is off, but Toadburt isn't free—he's working for the Shadow Estate's Archivist in exchange for gradual healing, recovering from his injuries over two-week intervals while organizing books in a vampire library. Waluigi recognizes this pattern: someone too damaged to refuse help, accepting terms from whoever offers it, trading independence for survival. It's not slavery. It's not freedom. It's the grey area in between that nobody likes to name. The Toadburt question has changed from unresolved suspicion to immediate rescue problem. Remi's exterior scouting confirmed an injured real Toadburt gathered at the master-bedroom portal circle with Tanukiburt and Mystic Morel while the rug was being covered and uncovered. This means Toadburt is alive, not free, and positioned at the exact route the party needs to use.
